learningObjectives: Understand how text is transformed into machine-readable features.
Identify common NLP tasks and their applications.

activities.title: Build a Text Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the major stages of a basic text preprocessing pipeline.

content.concept: NLP preprocessing can include normalization, tokenization, stop-word handling, and conversion of text into numerical features.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Explore Tokenization
activities.instruction: Explore how a sentence can be divided into smaller text units.

content.concept: Tokenization breaks text into units such as words, subwords, or sentences so that the text can be processed computationally.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The original text before it is divided into smaller units.
A complete sentence treated as one unit during sentence-level tokenization.
An individual word treated as a token.
A smaller piece of a word used by subword tokenization methods.
The ordered collection of tokens produced from the input text.

activities.title: Match NLP Tasks
activities.instruction: Match each NLP task with a suitable application.

content.concept: Different NLP tasks process language for different goals, including classification, entity extraction, translation, and summarization.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Sentiment Analysis → Determine whether text expresses positive, negative, or other sentiment
Text Classification → Assign text to predefined categories
Named Entity Recognition → Identify people, organizations, locations, and other entities
Machine Translation → Convert text from one language to another
Text Summarization → Produce a shorter representation of longer text
config.answer: Sentiment Analysis → Determine whether text expresses positive, negative, or other sentiment

activities.title: Build Text Features
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages for converting raw text into machine-readable features.

content.concept: Text can be represented numerically using methods such as bag-of-words, TF-IDF, or learned embeddings.
